scope: SBI recurring XRP accumulation and reward distribution
SBI Global Asset Management and SBI ARUHI shareholder rewards
actual capital versus reward face value

confirmed_findings.statement: SBI VC Trade offers scheduled crypto-asset accumulation and reward-conversion channels including XRP; the card and Orico programs are opt-in distribution mechanisms.
The SBI START Bond was a JPY 10 billion security-token bond issued on ibet for Fin and sold out; eligible investors were offered JPY 200 equivalent XRP per JPY 100,000 purchased.

The maximum theoretical SBI START Bond XRP reward face value is JPY 20 million if the entire JPY 10 billion issue qualifies and every eligible holder claims; actual claims and XRP units delivered remain unknown.
SBI Shinsei Bank offered JPY 500–20,000 equivalent XRP vouchers for qualifying six-month yen deposits; campaign windows ended March 31, 2026.
The SBI Shinsei release says vouchers would be emailed by the end of May but also references a July 2 XRP valuation time; the published chronology is internally inconsistent.
SBI Global Asset Management and SBI ARUHI published separate XRP shareholder-benefit programs; their recipient populations and claims must not be combined with SBI Holdings.
SBI VC Trade reported more than two million registered service accounts as of July 6, 2026, after the BITPoint Japan merger; this is not an XRP-holder or active-trader count.
SBI's XRP reward channels coexist with separate Circle/USDC/Arc, JPYSC and Ripple/XRPL initiatives; no exclusive XRP strategy is established.

bank_deposit_campaign.date_inconsistency: Voucher email by end of May; XRP quantity reference dated July 2, 2026.

competing_hypotheses.statement: SBI's accumulation, card, points, bond and shareholder-benefit products create a recurring/periodic XRP distribution funnel, but do not yet establish the amount of incremental spot buying.
SBI may fulfill rewards from existing inventory or OTC supply rather than open-market XRP purchases.
The SBI START Bond's published terms imply a JPY 20 million maximum theoretical XRP reward face value if the entire JPY 10 billion issue qualified and all eligible investors claimed.
SBI's XRP distribution channels coexist with its Ripple/XRPL, Circle/USDC/Arc and JPYSC activities; the evidence supports a multi-rail strategy, not exclusivity for XRP.
The two-million SBI VC Trade registered-account figure measures platform reach, not XRP holders, active traders or net XRP capital.
The SBI Shinsei deposit-campaign release contains an internal fulfillment-date inconsistency that prevents precise reconstruction of the XRP voucher delivery and valuation sequence.

feature_admission.reason: No disclosed program-level redemption totals, XRP sourcing, execution venue, customer selection share or reconciled net spot purchases.

forecast.reason: Product terms and theoretical reward face value do not establish incremental spot demand or a calibrated market signal.

next_actions: Obtain actual XRP units credited and claim counts for the SBI START Bond, card, Orico, deposit and shareholder programs.
Determine whether reward XRP is sourced from inventory, affiliate treasury, OTC counterparties or open-market executions.
Measure XRP/JPY depth, spreads, slippage and executed volume around each program's launch and fulfillment windows.
Separate SBI VC Trade registered accounts from active accounts and XRP-specific participation.
Track SBI Ripple Asia XRPL production milestones separately from conceptual proof-of-concept announcements.
Track SBI Circle Holdings, Arc, USDC and JPYSC as distinct rails; do not treat them as XRP capital.
Keep Japanese SBIC East Japan separate from SBI Holdings and SBI Circle Holdings.
safety: Public-source research only. No orders, credentials, private data, paper-position changes or external financial actions.
